title: Analysis code and database for "Non-cereal agroforestry as a globally overlooked reservoir of biodiversity and nutritional diversity"
description: R code and curated database used to produce all analyses and figures of a global systematic review of non-cereal agroforestry systems (4,512 paired experiments, 638 studies, 83 countries). Includes the experiment database, the species characteristics table, the ecosystem-service classification, and a README giving the run order and package requirements. No account or login is required to access or run the analysis.
